raw.query: WITH effective AS (SELECT static_encoder_workers_effective, binding_window_effective, static_as_ingested, binding_as_ingested FROM provenance.v_grid_static_effective), weekly AS (SELECT run_id, experiment, pool, window_name, policy, forecast_model, window_span_s, numerator_worker_seconds, denominator_kind, denominator_worker_seconds, denominator_workers, denominator_window, cost_ratio, denominator_window_mismatch FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE is_current = TRUE AND window_name = 'aggregate' AND forecast_model IS NOT NULL AND denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8'), breakdown AS (SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current = TRUE AND window_name <> 'aggregate') AS current_nonaggregate_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current = FALSE) AS superseded_rows FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio WHERE run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM weekly) GROUP BY run_id) SELECT w.*, w.numerator_worker_seconds / w.denominator_worker_seconds AS recomputed_ratio, e.static_encoder_workers_effective, e.binding_window_effective, e.static_as_ingested, e.binding_as_ingested, COALESCE(b.current_nonaggregate_rows, 0) AS current_nonaggregate_rows, COALESCE(b.superseded_rows, 0) AS superseded_rows FROM weekly w CROSS JOIN effective e LEFT JOIN breakdown b USING (run_id) ORDER BY w.run_id
